title: Build rules-pack audit and diff tooling
description: Create tooling to compare generated rules-pack outputs across runs, detect nondeterminism, list missing fields, flag suspicious parser failures, and produce human-readable import summaries.
acceptance_criteria:
- Audit command or script exists.
- Diff report identifies added/removed/changed records.
- Missing-field and parser-failure summaries are produced.
- Tooling is usable in CI or local verification.
notes: Implemented on work/loreweaver-0m9.10. PR #125 open. Adds packages/core/src/rules/audit.ts (auditPack + diffPacks, generic over RulesPack), packages/core/scripts/rules-pack-audit/cli.ts with audit/diff subcommands and --json/--strict flags, root npm scripts audit:rules-pack and diff:rules-pack, internal exports, 16 unit tests + 7 CLI smoke tests. Scope kept narrow per direction: no SRD vendoring (60z), no exact creature name-set check (0m9.5.14), no per-system coverage assertions (0m9.6/0m9.9). CI hard-gating left for a follow-up bead.
close_reason: Merged to main via PR #125 (squash c518f5c). Adds generic auditPack/diffPacks library, rules-pack-audit CLI with audit/diff subcommands, --json/--strict flags, root npm scripts, internal exports, and 20 tests (16 unit + 4 wiring assertions). Scope kept narrow: no SRD vendoring (60z), no exact creature name-set check (0m9.5.14), no per-system coverage assertions (0m9.6/0m9.9), no default CI hard-gate (follow-up). Follow-up commit on the same PR fixed the CLI usage docs and added an npm-script wiring regression test.
